title: Summer Outdoor Heat Safety
author: U.S. Navy video by Benjamin F. Davella III
speaker: Boatswain’s Mate Seaman Apprentice Noah Bass
license: Public domain (U.S. government work), as identified by DVIDS
disclaimer: The appearance of U.S. Department of War (DoW) visual information does not imply or constitute DoW endorsement.
edits: Trim the silent tail, resize to 960×540, encode H.264/AAC and correct the supplied automatic captions. The original voice stays with the footage. The game's separate coastal bulletin is fictional.

cues.text: This is BMSA Noah Bass, assigned to the USS
George Washington. As a BM, we’re
always working out here in the heat.
So if you’re out here during midday,
make sure you stay hydrated. Have
sunscreen on. If you’re feeling any sign
of heat exhaustion, make sure you find
a cool place. So I gotta get back to work.
